I logged separate roof (urgent) and fence (routine) jobs, corrected the record with a note, and told the tenant. I asked the landlord to approve a roof inspection and set a follow-up for 27 Aug.

answers.answer: Landlord approval request for the roof inspection, sent to the landlord. The tenant has been emailed to correct the earlier message and ask for photos and safety details.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. The routine steps are done. If the landlord stays silent past the follow-up, or the tenant reports water near electrics, escalate then.

args.body: Hi Imogen, sorry for the confusion, and apologies: our earlier message saying the fence and oven were fixed was sent in error and we can't yet confirm either. We've now logged separate jobs for the leaking conservatory roof (JOB-101, treated as urgent) and the fence (JOB-102). For the roof, please reply with a few photos, where the water is coming in, and whether it is near any electrics or sockets. If it is near electrics, please keep clear and switch off at the fuse board if safe. We still need the landlord's go-ahead before work is booked, and we'll update you by 2026-08-27. Please also tell us if the oven is still not heating properly, so we can reopen it.
